mutants.name: skip-bullet-removal
mutants.why: passing plan_text unchanged (no bullet removal) makes rule 22 (a) see the expected-missing paths and fail on them; t11 expects rc 0 with the bullets gone

mutants.name: drop-mutation-gate-skip
mutants.why: always calling _gate_mutation_result when a run file is expected missing causes a 'manifest without run' FAIL; t11 expects 0 failures

mutants.name: drop-present-path-guard
mutants.why: removing the os.path.exists check lets the flag ride to the second commit undetected; t12 expects FAIL expect_missing when the dev-log is present

mutants.name: drop-undeclared-path-guard
mutants.why: removing the all_deposits_norm check allows naming paths not in the step's Deposits block; t14 expects FAIL expect_missing for an undeclared path
